slides.headline: How to buy Bitcoin [$100 a month] in 3 numbers

slides.title: 1. Buy the same $100 every month
paras: 60 buys since Dec 2021: $6,000 in. Your average Bitcoin price: <g>$43,200</g>. Nov 26 close: $60,495.
slides.source: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD + SPY closes, cross-checked with Coin Metrics / Nasdaq

slides.title: 2. All at once? It depends
slides.text: Bought at a top? [Monthly] won. Steady climb? All at once.

slides.title: 3. Keep buying in the dips
paras: Jul 2022: $800 in, worth <r>$424</r>. Oct 2025: $14,441. Past data, not a forecast.
slides.source: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD closes, Coin Metrics PriceUSD

sources: Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes; Coin Metrics community API PriceUSD (max diff 0.6% on the 60 buy dates). $100 bought at the close of the 1st calendar day of each month, Dec 1 2021 to Nov 1 2026 (60 buys, $6,000). Valued at Nov 26 2026 close $60,494.71 (Yahoo) / $60,415 (Coin Metrics): DCA $8,402 / $8,392, avg cost $43,202 / $43,193; lump sum Dec 1 2021 at $57,230: $6,342 / $6,339. Worst: Jul 1 2022 $424 on $800 (-47%); peak Oct 1 2025 $14,441.

SPY (S&P 500 ETF) closes, Yahoo Finance + Nasdaq.com historical (identical): $100 on the first trading day of each month Dec 1 2021 to Nov 2 2026, valued at Nov 25 2026 close $716.70: DCA $8,383 (avg $512.95), lump Dec 1 2021 at $450.50: $9,545. Price only, dividends not included.
